parsed.title: Discussion on taxes, domain purchase, app profitability and security concerns

topics.title: Avoiding large tax penalties with aunt Sveta's help

claims.text: Paying aunt Sveta 500 UAH helps avoid a huge main penalty caused by a mis‑marked column in the declaration
The inspector was corrupt, approving declarations without review for a year and later reprimanded, prompting a full re‑check
With Sveta’s assistance the author correctly re‑filed and paid about 1000 UAH instead of all fines

topics.title: Domain purchase and need for a FOP calculator

claims.text: The author has not bought a domain yet
A FOP calculator is needed; once someone buys it, there will be money for the domain
The tax calculation procedure takes about an hour with Excel, at most a day
Quarterly reports must be filed and taxes paid correctly
The main difficulty is not the calculation itself but correctly matching each column and subtraction

topics.title: Profitability of a web/Flutter app idea

claims.text: Web platforms are the simplest but far less profitable than Android/iOS apps
SEO is poor, no external traffic from social media, no ad revenue, and user retention is almost zero due to paywalls
Successful projects use fast delivery (< 1 week) and a cross‑platform stack like Flutter, copying popular ideas with minor tweaks
The author doubts anyone will buy the product, betting on low sales
LinkedIn audience for technical/managerial posts has dropped below 50%
The calculator works only with a UAH‑based FOP, requiring conversion at the day‑rate of each transaction
Before proceeding, at least ten people should be willing to pay 299 UAH; otherwise the analysis is pointless

topics.title: Potential password leak in bundled app

claims.text: The source code may contain a hard‑coded password stored in local storage
The author jokes about many LinkedIn users being able to hack it
The app is positioned as a local‑first bundle with a password that unlocks full features

openQuestions.text: Can the hard‑coded password be found by searching the source code?
